thread:
Anna (runtime): Pushed a small-batch scheduler tweak (v1.3.2) to the canary group at 02:10 UTC. Quick wins so far: p50 gen latency ~18% down, p99 ~7% down, and per-token cost for short-turn generation ~32% lower. Rolling paused — validating region parity and metrics. :tada:

Mike L: Awesome! How did you measure the cost reduction? link to dashboard?

Anna (runtime): Measured via the token-cost pipeline + perf traces. Canary was 10% of traffic in us-west-2 for 3 hours. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/bscheduler (private). Key change was enabling adaptive batching + smaller max batch for short_seq routes. Config snippet we used:

```
routes:
  short_seq:
    max_batch_size: 16
    adaptive_batch_threshold: 0.6
    kv_cache_prefill: true
```

Jess R: Nice. Any impact on chat endpoints / chat-like sessions?

Anna (runtime): Chat saw p50 ~10% improvement, p99 roughly flat. We kept kv_cache_prefill on so KV hit rates stayed high which protects tail latency. Overall throughput increased so unit cost fell.

Sam - infra: Curious about GPU packing/utilization — did that change? Any risk of OOMs or longer GC pauses?

Anna (runtime): GPU utilization up ~12% on canary hosts, better packing across small requests. No OOMs in the canary window, autoscaler behaved normally. We also instrumented host-level memfd churn and it's steady.

deploy-bot: canary deployment completed: deploy/scheduler-v1.3.2 - 1765001200

Katherine (prodeng): This is great — recommend promoting to 50% traffic tomorrow at 17:00 UTC if no regressions. Also please add a short note for release notes and an ops play if rollback needed.

Anna (runtime): Agreed. I'll promote to 50% tomorrow at 17:00 UTC, add the rollout plan to #release-war-room, and include an automatic rollback trigger (error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m).

Mike L: Could you add a short blurb so we can highlight this in next all-hands? 2 slides max.

Anna (runtime): Will do — posting summary + numbers in #all-hands by EOD. Thanks team! :rocket:

Jess R: Huge win, thanks all for the quick follow-through.
